sources.summary: Promotion: a Vietnamese temple and a Mexican tequila factory are among the eclectic winners of this year's Brick Award programme. The six winners of Brick Award 2026 also include an infill housing project in Belgium, a series of student-designed brick structures in China, a cliffside Mallorcan house and a social housing block in Spain.
